note: The tightest ICP match in this batch on every criterion as written. Successful: chef and restaurateur who has owned and operated top-ten-in-country venues and now consults on restaurants and hotel design in Finland, the USA and New York — a business owner in the literal sense the quote uses. Income: states it plainly, 'I'm pretty comfortable' and 'I've got the money to be able to spend, and I'm happy to invest in my health and my education', and he distances himself from people seeking a cheap taste. Neglected health: exactly the stated pattern — everything else is dialled in and the last six months of training have been maintenance at best, with the only symptoms a softer torso and a cardiovascular drift from 140 to 170 bpm at the same pace. Good to great: near-literal, self-rating four or five out of ten on body composition with functional mastery rather than rescue as the goal. Not deconditioned: 6'5" and roughly 190 lb at 47, ultramarathon history, a 212 bpm max heart rate, no injuries. He is the prospect the ICP describes and he did not buy — which makes this the useful inverse of the case already on file where someone outside the stated ICP closed at full price. The gap here was not qualification but packaging: he wanted the same programme staged, and he was never offered a payment plan. Worth carrying into the rollup that ICP fit and conversion are diverging in both directions in this corpus.
